import pandas as pd
from collections import defaultdict
fp = "/Data2/.../9b54f9d9-35ee-4a14-b62f-d130ea00317f_extracted/food_duplicates.xls"
df = pd.read_excel(fp)
items = [str(x).strip() for x in df.values.flatten() if pd.notnull(x)]
# Known synonym groups
syn_groups = [
    {"aubergine","eggplant"}, {"java","coffee"}, {"candy floss","cotton candy"},
    {"puffed rice","rice krispies"}, {"buffalo wings","hot wings"},
    {"garbanzo bean","chickpea"}, {"capsicum","bell pepper"}, {"arugula","rocket"},
    {"fatty goose liver","foie gras"}, {"calf thymus","sweetbread"},
    {"veal","calf meat"}, {"beef","cow meat"}, {"craisins","dried cranberries"},
    {"soda","pop"}, {"angel hair pasta","capellini"}, {"pasties","hand pies"},
    {"skewer","shish kebab"}, {"mudbug","crawdad"}, {"rice porridge","congee"},
    {"beetroot","beet"}, {"icing sugar","confectioner's sugar"}, {"fairy cake","cupcake"},
    {"soy curds","tofu"}, {"venison","deer meat"}, {"chips","fries"},
    {"bombay duck","lizardfish"}, {"jelly donut","jam doughnut"}, {"sultana","golden raisin"}
]
# Map each item to a canonical rep (min string in its group)
canon = {}
for g in syn_groups:
    m = min(g)
    for w in g:
        canon[w] = m
norm = [canon.get(x,x) for x in items]
# Count canonical occurrences
from collections import Counter
cnt = Counter(norm)
# Find items whose canonical count is 1 and that don't appear in any synonym group
unique_raw = []
for x in items:
    cx = canon.get(x,x)
    if cnt[cx] == 1:
        unique_raw.append(x)
unique_set = sorted(set(unique_raw))
print("Candidate unique items (no synonyms present):", unique_set)
